You can start a personal return or exchange through the Return Portal. 
Enter your order number and the email address or shipping postal/ZIP code associated with the order.
Select Start a return/exchange.
Choose the items, select a reason, then choose Exchange or Return it.
Follow the prompts to submit your request and receive your return instructions and label.

turns.q: How do I track the status of my refund?
turns.replyTail: can track the return using the tracking number on the return label emailed to you. Returns typically take 3–14 days to reach us, followed by up to 3–5 working days for processing. After processing, a refund to your original payment method may take up to 7 business days to appear, depending on your bank. If you selected store credit, it should arrive by email within 24 hours; please check your spam or junk folder if you don’t see it. You can also check your return, refund, or store credit status.
